summary: Plan r3 applies the review r1 rulings. P4 now checks for other slices' unpushed commits before the run's first push, publishes aac-tools and stops for the restart; P5 then checks the sidecar's --help (F1, F3). The carriers are listed with gitblit and proven with GitHub trees (F2, V12). The sweep is split into 10 phases sized from Jenkins build durations, each class opening with a canary (F4, F5). No carrier is a phase Target any more, so an archived HelmCharts is left alone. The dry run parses 18 phases.
